question.:question/problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186119744/plots/curve-9594d834d58e31e448d5d485.png)

Find the arc length of the curve $g(t)=⟨7\left(\operatorname{ln}⁡t-\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}\right),\,7\left(2t\right)⟩$ from $t=1$ to $t=e.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find ${g}^{′}(t)$ and $‖{g}^{′}(t)‖:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{g}^{′}(t) & =7\left(⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡t-\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2t)⟩\right)\\  & =7\left(⟨\frac{1}{t}-t,\,2⟩\right)\\ ‖{g}^{′}(t)‖ & =7\left(\sqrt{{(\frac{1}{t}-t)}^{2}+{2}^{2}}\right)\\  & =7\left(\sqrt{\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}-2+{t}^{2}+4}\right)\\  & =7\left(\sqrt{\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}+2+{t}^{2}}\right)\\  & =7\left(\sqrt{{(\frac{1}{t}+t)}^{2}}\right)\\  & =7\left(\frac{1}{t}+t\right)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the arc length of the curve is

$$
\begin{aligned}L & ={\int }_{1}^{e}‖{g}^{′}(t)‖\,\text{d}t\\  & =7\left({\int }_{1}^{e}(\frac{1}{t}+t)\,\text{d}t\right)\\  & =7\left((\operatorname{ln}⁡t+\frac{{t}^{2}}{2}){|}_{1}^{e}\right)\\  & =7\left((\operatorname{ln}⁡e+\frac{{e}^{2}}{2})-(\operatorname{ln}⁡1+\frac{{1}^{2}}{2})\right)\\  & =7\left(1+\frac{{e}^{2}}{2}-0-\frac{1}{2}\right)\\  & =7\left(\frac{{e}^{2}+1}{2}\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Find the arc length of the curve $g(t)=⟨10\left(2{t}^{3/2}\right),\,10\left(3t\right)⟩$ from $t=0$ to $t=3.$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we find ${g}^{′}(t)$ and $‖{g}^{′}(t)‖:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{g}^{′}(t) & =10\left(⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2{t}^{3/2}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(3t)⟩\right)\\  & =10\left(⟨3\sqrt{t},\,3⟩\right)\\ ‖{g}^{′}(t)‖ & =10\left(\sqrt{(3\sqrt{t})^{2}+{3}^{2}}\right)\\  & =10\left(\sqrt{9t+9}\right)\\  & =10\left(3\sqrt{t+1}\right)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the arc length of the curve is

$$
\begin{aligned}L & ={\int }_{0}^{3}‖{g}^{′}(t)‖\,\text{d}t\\  & =10\left({\int }_{0}^{3}3\sqrt{t+1}\,\text{d}t\right)\\  & =10\left({\int }_{0}^{3}3(t+1)^{1/2}\,\text{d}t\right)\\  & =10\left(2(t+1)^{3/2}{|}_{0}^{3}\right)\\  & =10\left(16-2\right)\\  & =10\left(14\right).\end{aligned}
$$
